peel.en: Please peel the orange before adding it to the fruit salad.
peel.zh: 把柳橙加入水果沙拉前，請先剝皮。

peep.en: A tiny bird gave a soft peep from the nest.
peep.zh: 一隻小鳥從巢裡發出輕輕的啾聲。

peer.en: Each student asked a peer to review the first draft.
peer.zh: 每位學生都請一位同儕檢查初稿。

penalty.en: The referee explained the penalty before play resumed.
penalty.zh: 比賽恢復前，裁判說明了這次判罰。

pending.en: The final decision is still pending further review by the committee.
pending.zh: 最終決定仍在等待委員會進一步審查。

penetrate.en: Sunlight can penetrate the clear water near the shore.
penetrate.zh: 陽光可以穿透岸邊清澈的水。

penguin.en: A penguin moved carefully across the ice in the documentary.
penguin.zh: 紀錄片裡一隻企鵝小心地走過冰面。

peninsula.en: The map shows a long peninsula extending into the sea.
peninsula.zh: 地圖顯示一條長半島伸入海中。

penny.en: He found an old penny inside the wooden box.
penny.zh: 他在木盒裡找到一枚舊便士。

pension.en: The article explains how a pension supports people after retirement.
pension.zh: 文章說明退休金如何在退休後提供生活支持。

pepper.en: She added a little pepper to the soup before serving it.
pepper.zh: 她在上湯前加了一點胡椒。

per.en: The bus arrives three times per hour during the afternoon.
per.zh: 下午時段每小時有三班公車。

perception.en: Media coverage can influence public perception of an event.
perception.zh: 媒體報導可能影響大眾對事件的看法。

perch.en: Two birds perch on the fence every morning.
perch.zh: 每天早上都有兩隻鳥停在籬笆上。

perfection.en: The teacher said improvement matters more than perfection.
perfection.zh: 老師說進步比追求完美更重要。

performer.en: Each performer waited quietly behind the stage curtain.
performer.zh: 每位表演者都安靜地在舞台布幕後等待。

perfume.en: A light perfume scent remained in the empty room.
perfume.zh: 空房間裡仍留著淡淡的香水味。

peril.en: The story places the explorers in peril during a sudden storm.
peril.zh: 故事讓探險者在突如其來的暴風雨中陷入危險。

perish.en: Many plants may perish when a severe drought lasts too long.
perish.zh: 嚴重乾旱持續太久時，許多植物可能枯死。

permanent.en: The school installed a permanent sign beside the entrance.
permanent.zh: 學校在入口旁裝設了一面永久標示。

permissible.en: Only approved materials are permissible during the laboratory activity.
permissible.zh: 實驗活動期間只允許使用核准的材料。

permission.en: Students need permission before using the auditorium after school.
permission.zh: 學生放學後使用禮堂前需要獲得許可。

persevere.en: She continued to persevere even when the project became difficult.
persevere.zh: 即使專題變得困難，她仍持續堅持下去。

persistence.en: His persistence helped him improve his English writing over time.
persistence.zh: 他的毅力幫助他逐漸改善英文寫作。

personality.en: Her friendly personality made group discussions more comfortable.
personality.zh: 她友善的個性讓小組討論更自在。

personnel.en: School personnel checked the building before the event opened.
personnel.zh: 活動開始前，校方人員檢查了校舍。

persuasion.en: The advertisement relies on emotion as a form of persuasion.
persuasion.zh: 這則廣告運用情感作為說服方式。

persuasive.en: Her essay was persuasive because it used clear evidence.
persuasive.zh: 她的文章因為使用清楚證據而很有說服力。

pessimism.en: Too much pessimism can make a difficult problem seem impossible.
pessimism.zh: 過度悲觀可能讓困難的問題看起來無法解決。

pessimistic.en: He felt pessimistic at first but changed his view later.
pessimistic.zh: 他一開始很悲觀，但後來改變了看法。

pest.en: Farmers monitor the field for signs of pest damage.
pest.zh: 農民會觀察田地是否出現害蟲造成的損害。

pet.en: Her pet waits by the door when she returns home.
pet.zh: 她回家時，寵物會在門邊等她。

petition.en: Students submitted a petition requesting longer library hours.
petition.zh: 學生提交請願書，希望延長圖書館開放時間。

petrol.en: The article compares petrol use with newer transportation alternatives.
petrol.zh: 文章比較汽油使用與較新的交通替代方案。

petroleum.en: The lesson examined how petroleum is used in modern industry.
petroleum.zh: 課堂探討石油在現代工業中的用途。

petty.en: The teacher encouraged them not to argue over petty differences.
petty.zh: 老師鼓勵他們不要為小事爭執。

phase.en: The project entered its final phase after months of preparation.
phase.zh: 經過數月準備後，專題進入最後階段。

philosopher.en: The class read a short passage by an ancient philosopher.
philosopher.zh: 班上閱讀了一段古代哲學家的短文。

philosophical.en: The novel raises a philosophical question about freedom and responsibility.
philosophical.zh: 這本小說提出一個關於自由與責任的哲學問題。

philosophy.en: Her teaching philosophy emphasizes curiosity and independent thinking.
philosophy.zh: 她的教學理念重視好奇心與獨立思考。

photograph.en: The old photograph shows the town before the station was built.
photograph.zh: 這張老照片顯示車站興建前的城鎮樣貌。

photographer.en: The photographer waited for better light before taking the picture.
photographer.zh: 攝影師等到光線更好後才拍照。

photographic.en: The exhibition contains photographic records of the city's history.
photographic.zh: 展覽收錄了這座城市歷史的攝影紀錄。

photography.en: She joined the photography club to learn better composition skills.
photography.zh: 她加入攝影社學習更好的構圖技巧。

physicist.en: The physicist explained the experiment to a group of students.
physicist.zh: 那位物理學家向一群學生說明實驗。

pianist.en: The young pianist performed a short piece at the concert.
pianist.zh: 年輕鋼琴家在音樂會演奏了一首短曲。

piano.en: A piano stood in the corner of the music room.
piano.zh: 音樂教室角落放著一架鋼琴。

pickle.en: He added a slice of pickle to his sandwich.
pickle.zh: 他在三明治裡加了一片醃黃瓜。

pickpocket.en: The travel guide warned visitors to watch for a pickpocket in crowded areas.
pickpocket.zh: 旅遊指南提醒遊客在人多的地方注意扒手。

pickup.en: The school arranged a pickup point beside the main gate.
pickup.zh: 學校在大門旁安排了一個接送點。
